candidates.old:
LDA hist_edge_lo,X
    STA edge_screen_address_low
    LDA hist_edge_hi,X
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    LDA hist_src_hi,X               \ the slot: the 8 operands' high byte
    CMP src0 + 2                    \ the 8 always hold one value: unchanged, nothing to write
    BEQ same_slot
    STA src0 + 2
    STA src1 + 2
    STA src2 + 2
    STA src3 + 2
    STA src4 + 2
    STA src5 + 2
    STA src6 + 2
    STA src7 + 2
.same_slot
    LDX #&C8                        \ the history's bytes from the top: X - 1 - line
.group
    LDY #0
.src0
    LDA hist0 - 1 - 0,X             \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.src1
    LDA hist0 - 1 - 1,X             \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.src2
    LDA hist0 - 1 - 2,X             \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.src3
    LDA hist0 - 1 - 3,X             \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.src4
    LDA hist0 - 1 - 4,X             \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
candidates.new:
LDA hist_edge_lo,X
    STA edge_screen_address_low
    LDA hist_edge_hi,X
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    TXA                             \ the slot: the 8 operands' high byte, HI(hist0) or HI(hist1)
    ORA #HI(hist0)
    CMP wcx_u0 + 2                  \ the 8 always hold one value: unchanged, nothing to write
    BEQ wcx_same
    STA wcx_u0 + 2
    STA wcx_u1 + 2
    STA wcx_u2 + 2
    STA wcx_u3 + 2
    STA wcx_u4 + 2
    STA wcx_u5 + 2
    STA wcx_u6 + 2
    STA wcx_u7 + 2
.wcx_same
    LDX #&C0                        \ the group's base in the history: hist + 7 - line + X, X = 192 down to 0 (no page crossing)
    CLC                             \ C = 0 here and at the end of each group
.group
    LDY #0
.wcx_u0
    LDA hist0 + 7,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u1
    LDA hist0 + 6,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u2
    LDA hist0 + 5,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u3
    LDA hist0 + 4,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u4
    LDA hist0 + 3,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u5
    LDA hist0 + 2,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u6
    LDA hist0 + 1,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    INY
.wcx_u7
    LDA hist0 + 0,X                 \ self-modified: hist0 or hist1
    STA (edge_screen_address),Y
    TXA
    ADC #&F8                        \ X - 8 (C = 0 in): C = 1 unless this was the group at X = 0
    BCC wcx_done_u
    TAX
    LDA edge_screen_address_low     \ down a character row: &280, round the 16K screen
    ADC #&7F                        \ C = 1: + &80
    STA edge_screen_address_low
    LDA edge_screen_address_high
    ADC #&02                        \ C = 0 after: the high byte is at most &82
    STA edge_screen_address_high    \ (N still the sum's)
    BPL group                       \ the hot path
    EOR #&C0                        \ &80-&82 -> &40-&42: - &40
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    BRA group
.wcx_done_u
    RTS
candidates.summary: write_column: one loop with the history read at hist+7-line+X, X = 192 down to 0 (no page crossing: the original's hist0-1-k,X base always crossed, 5 cycles a load), C=0 carried from the high-byte ADC so the SEC goes, the pointer's high byte stored before the wrap test (BPL). The loop is the whole of write_column's body now: the old src5.. tail after the window is left as unreachable code (its BRA group still assembles).
candidates.equivalence: Group g (X0 = 200-8g in the old code) read hist+X0-1-k for k=0..7 and stored it at the pointer+k; the new X = 192-8g reads hist+7-k+X = the same address, so the same 200 bytes go to the same 25 groups of 8 in the same order. The operands' high byte (self-modified as before, by the same slot) is HI(hist0)/HI(hist1) = HI(hist0 - 1)+1; TXA/ORA #HI(hist0) makes it from the slot (ASSERT-worthy: HI(hist0) is even and hist1 = hist0 + &100, both true: &B8/&B9). The old code's CMP/BEQ cache on src0+2 is the same, on the new operand. Loop end: old BEQ after SBC #8 at X=8 (25th group); new BCC after ADC #&F8 at X=0 (A=&F8, C=0) is the 25th group likewise; C=1 on every other group (X>=8) so ADC #&7F is + &80 as before; C=0 at the loop top because the high byte's ADC #2 (at most &7F+2+1) cannot carry and EOR does not touch C, and CLC before the first group. The high byte is stored before the BPL: on the wrap path it holds &80-&82 for the three instructions until EOR #&C0/STA (nothing reads &86 meanwhile: write_column is in the main thread, not the interrupt, and the pointer is the renderer's own). The final pointer (not updated after the last group) is the same. Exit state differs (old A=0,X=8,C=1,Z=1; new A=&F8,X=0,C=0,Z=0), Y=7 as before: the only caller (JSR write_column, line 507) goes to ren_plot_lives, which starts with loads and compares and reads none of A/X/Y/flags, and X is reloaded after it (LDX pending_slot,Y or LDX #2). `.group` is kept as the loop's label since the (now unreachable) tail's BRA group needs it; `done`/`wrap` stay defined in the tail.
candidates.relies_on: Measured in a scratch build (DEBUG_LIVES bench, pcprof seed 1 / RIGHT): render 23430 -> 23266 and 28406 -> 28108 cycles a pass (-164 / -298); passlock state+screen identical to the control, seed 1 6000 passes and seed 3 4000 passes. Growth +45 bytes: bench build leaves 86 bytes under REN_BASE (131 before), the gameplay build assembles (about 15 left; a larger variant with two loops, +99, overran it by 39 and was dropped), shipping build assembles. Page crossings: the loop is &9671-&96BB, wholly in page &96 (BPL group, BRA group, BCC/ BMI never cross); the new LDAs read hist0+7..0,X with X<=192: never cross (the old ones always did: base low byte &FF-k, X>=k+1). add_scroll_zone and everything after it in bank 4 moves up 45 bytes (&96C3 -> &96F0, render_end &A366 -> &A393), moving every table and hot branch after it; measured whole-pass total includes that and still shows the saving. Self-modified operands: wcx_u0..wcx_u7 + 2 are written only by this routine; src0..src4 no longer exist (grep: only write_column used them; src5+2..src7+2 stores are gone, the tail is unreachable). tools/frontend.mjs's write_column.column_source is already a stale name. hist_src_hi table stays (now unread). pcprof/passbench count columns by pc === write_column: still the first instruction.
